concerns.text: The contract `contracts/detection_results.schema.yaml` requires the fields `pipeline`, `prediction`, `latency_ms`, and all feature columns in every CSV it validates. The plan states that `data/features.csv` will be validated against this contract, yet `features.csv` does not contain a `pipeline` column (or `prediction`/`latency_ms`). This creates a mismatch between the contract and the artifact produced.

Phase 4 describes merging `features.csv`, `tide_lite_enriched.csv`, and `tide_original_enriched.csv` into a single `data/merged_results.csv`. If the merge is performed as a wide join (adding separate columns for each pipeline), the resulting file will not satisfy `detection_results.schema.yaml`, which expects one row per `pipeline`. The plan should clarify that the merge produces a *long* format (two rows per instance, one per pipeline) or provide a separate schema for the wide‑format merge.
